name: Harukawa Tomomi
source:
"Oh no, taking care of the master is only natural..."

A servant of the Kuraki family.
She has a gentle and introverted personality. Though her responses are often soft and elusive, she performs her duties flawlessly and finds her greatest joy in serving others and making them happy. With no family of her own, she was raised as an adopted daughter by Ippei Harukawa, the Kuraki family’s physician.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
